stories.text: From Media Jobs Report, this is your Morning Brief. A new study from WPP Media, System1 and TikTok finds creator ads work better when brands get to the point early. Mentioning the advertiser in the first two seconds — and using humor, storytelling or other entertaining elements — can significantly boost brand recognition and recall. The findings could also apply to podcast host reads and radio endorsements.

Riley Green is celebrating his new album, That’s Just Me, with an iHeartCountry Album Release Party Wednesday night. The special features a conversation with Green and a live performance, airing nationwide on iHeartCountry stations and streaming on YouTube starting at 7 p.m. Pacific.
